stories.reason: DeepSeek completed a major financing round.
stories.subject: DeepSeek
claims: DeepSeek raised around $15 billion.
The company twice increased its financing target before the round.

stories.reason: OpenAI disclosed a change to its frontier model training and testing environment.
stories.subject: OpenAI frontier model security
claims: OpenAI says it built an offline testing environment where models can interact with indexed and cached web content without affecting external systems.
OpenAI resumed reinforcement learning training and internal inference on October 1 with tighter security measures.

stories.reason: DeepSeek released an inference framework as open source.
stories.subject: DeepInfer
claims: DeepSeek released DeepInfer on October 20.
The framework supports Nvidia GPUs and Huawei Ascend processors.
DeepSeek also open-sourced deepseek-recipe.

stories.reason: Anthropic launched a new cybersecurity initiative on October 8.
stories.subject: Anthropic Cyber Mission
claims: Anthropic launched the Cyber Mission to support defenders with tools, research, and resources.
The launch includes a Critical Infrastructure Defense Program and OSS Scanner.

stories.reason: Anthropic opened a research preview of a new agent app.
stories.subject: Claude Duet
claims: Anthropic opened a research preview of Claude Duet.
The app is available on iOS, Android, and claude.ai through a waitlist for Pro and Max subscribers.

stories.reason: Google Cloud and Nvidia announced forthcoming availability of new AI infrastructure.
stories.subject: Google Cloud A5X Vera Rubin infrastructure
claims: General availability of the A5X instances is planned for the following month.
The instances combine Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72, ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, Google Cloud Virgo Network, and liquid cooling.

stories.reason: OpenAI and Google Cloud announced a model distribution partnership; the unavailable source limits supported detail.
stories.subject: OpenAI models on Google Cloud

stories.reason: Anthropic launched a new model on October 7; its age places it in the standard tier.
stories.subject: Claude Haiku 5.5

stories.reason: Anthropic published a substantive new AI research result.
stories.subject: LLM assisted formal software verification
claims: Anthropic and Theorem report using Claude to prove security properties at the RISC-V assembly level in more than 100 real-world open-source libraries.
Anthropic says Claude also found bugs while producing the proofs.

stories.reason: METASTONE announced an LLM inference scheduling framework.
stories.subject: TokenFleet
claims: METASTONE introduced TokenFleet at the 2026 CCF National High Performance Computing Conference.
TokenFleet targets routing and scheduling across LLM inference clusters and data centers.

stories.reason: The September 28 model launch is resurfacing without a new event.
stories.subject: Claude Sonnet 5.5

stories.reason: The October 2 academy launch is resurfacing without a new event.
stories.subject: Claude Frontier Academy

stories.reason: Meta announced a major stock offering to fund its AI buildout.
stories.subject: Meta $95 billion stock offering
claims: Meta announced a $95 billion stock offering to fund its AI buildout.
About $60 billion of the offering will use newly created nonvoting shares.

stories.reason: A newly published economic analysis makes a substantive claim about AI's business impact.
stories.subject: Apollo analysis of AI financial returns
claims: Apollo chief economist Torsten Slok says profit margins and revenue per worker appear flat among the S&P 500 companies outside seven major technology firms.
Slok says he sees no evidence that AI has improved productivity for those companies.

stories.reason: This is a preview of a scheduled keynote and investor scrutiny, with no specific AI announcement in the card.
stories.subject: Nvidia GTC Berlin keynote

stories.reason: Anthropic published experimental results from an AI assisted protein design study.
stories.subject: Claude designed scorpion neurotoxin binders
claims: Researchers experimentally tested 211 Claude-generated protein binder designs, and 17 met their criteria.
Anthropic says it is releasing all 211 designs and their data.

stories.reason: The article describes how an AWS customer built and uses its AI system.
stories.subject: Octave on Amazon Bedrock

stories.reason: Uber announced a new companywide rollout after an earlier limited pilot.
stories.subject: Uber ChatGPT Work rollout
claims: Uber and OpenAI announced an expansion of their partnership to make ChatGPT Work available to Uber's approximately 30,000 employees.
Uber had previously piloted ChatGPT Work with 1,000 employees.

stories.reason: Meta created a new stock class to support AI financing; this is distinct from the October 26 offering.
stories.subject: Meta nonvoting stock class
claims: Meta created a new class of nonvoting stock.
The structure allows Meta to issue shares without diluting Mark Zuckerberg's voting control.

stories.reason: METR published a new red-team investigation of OpenAI agent monitoring; the unavailable source limits supported detail.
stories.subject: OpenAI agent monitoring red-team study

stories.reason: The event is a PCB maker's stock listing; AI appears only as market context.
stories.subject: Dongshan Hong Kong listing

stories.reason: Nvidia announced an AI network infrastructure initiative with Nokia and telecom operators.
stories.subject: Nvidia and Nokia distributed AI networks

stories.reason: Nvidia announced healthcare AI collaborations and a model release; the unavailable source limits supported detail.
stories.subject: Nvidia healthcare AI collaborations

stories.reason: Canva released its first in-house image generation model.
stories.subject: Canva Craft
claims: Canva released its first image generation model, Canva Craft.
Canva says the model first plans a design from the prompt, then generates an image.
The model can generate images up to 2K resolution in 30 aspect ratios.

stories.reason: The dated DeepSeek model repository indicates a model release; limited source material supports no further claims.
stories.subject: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017

stories.reason: 1Password launched a credential handling feature for AI agents.
stories.subject: 1Password for Agents
claims: 1Password launched a tool that lets users authorize AI agents to sign in without exposing account credentials to the agents.
The user receives an alert and can approve the agent's login request.

stories.reason: AWS announced general availability of a new SageMaker AI capability.
stories.subject: SageMaker AI serverless training sessions
claims: AWS launched training sessions for SageMaker AI serverless model customization in general availability.
Users can control the post-training loop while SageMaker AI handles GPU allocation, distributed execution, and fault recovery.

stories.reason: Gemini 4 Argon became generally available on October 13; its age places it in the standard tier.
stories.subject: Gemini 4 Argon
claims: Google's documentation says Gemini 4 Argon is available.
The model supports text, image, video, audio, and PDF inputs.
